parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.<props="china"> You can call [DescribeDomainInfo](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomaininfo?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) to obtain the ID.</props>
<props="intl">You can call [DescribeDomainInfo](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomaininfo?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) to obtain the ID.</props>

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default: en

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from 1. Default: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.
